text: There is a bug here: using the path tool i made a quick car body [Image #1] and then i try to loop cut it, it doesnt show me any loop cuts nor can it cut it it seems. ok but then i loop cut a cube [Image #2] and it breaks the model [Image #3]
resolution: Made Loop Cut obey the indexed Blockbench-style boundary for mixed path-plane and cube models. A concave Path Plane is one authored n-gon, so it now reports that no quad/triangle loop crosses it and offers Close instead of a misleading Apply. Failed/no-op previews can no longer journal, renumber part ranges, re-key an untouched mesh, or reselect another outliner; successful reselection is constrained to the seed part. Added a Zig regression proving a refused concave path cut is inert and a sibling cube loop cut leaves the path face and its four lowered triangles unchanged. ReleaseFast editor build, Zig mesh-edit tests, TypeScript check, and all 49 editor TS suites pass.
